items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: And the dance with officers Sam Knight, where the chief would take the band, the big band, I'd take the Dixieland band and go play for the crew.

ctx.x: I was sitting on my step. I told my wife, I said, after I come out to Navy, you know, well, sticking to that music so hard, I mean, blowing so much. I was playing baritone with one of the concerted bands. I was playing baritone and clarinet with the big orchestra. I was playing tenor with the parade band. And I was playing tenor with one of the concerted bands. And I was playing alto in my Dixieland band. See, I had a Dixieland band. And the chief, sometime we had to play a crew dance. And the dance with officers…
Now, this was the Opera House bar, but one is still there.
